question: Choose the word that is the most appropriate synonym of the word "brisk".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quick**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"brisk"** means active, fast, and energetic in movement or action. (तेज़ और ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example:** He took a brisk walk in the park to clear his mind.
 
 
• **"Quick"** refers to something done with speed or rapidity. It is closely synonymous with "brisk." (तेज़)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a quick reply to the email before heading out.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"brisk"** is **"quick"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quick**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slow** (धीमा): Not moving quickly or taking a long time to complete something.
 
 
• **Example:** The traffic was moving very slow due to heavy rain.
 
 
 
• **Weak** (कमज़ोर): Lacking strength or energy.
 
 
• **Example:** After recovering from illness, she felt weak and tired.
 
 
 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.
 
 
• **Example:** He spent the entire day being lazy and watching TV.
